ProxiClean offers significant benefits for households with pets or allergy sufferers due to its high-efficiency filter, which likely captures fine dust and dander. The advanced mapping technology and app-controlled customization provide users with precise control over cleaning schedules and areas, enhancing convenience and efficiency. Its low-profile design is a key feature for maintaining cleanliness in hard-to-reach spots under furniture, while the auto-return and charge function ensures the device is always prepared for use without manual intervention. These features combine to offer a strong market appeal for busy homeowners seeking a hands-off, thorough cleaning solution.
